requirements.statement: Add a Phase 3B bridge persistence API that records one immutable bundled Full resolution-to-project identity from a ready Phase 3A preflight result and rejects unsafe or inconsistent input before writing.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: This bridge already owns official-mode identity persistence and Phase 3A bundled Full preflight composition, so it is the single owner for freezing that ready identity before later public-route wiring.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: Bridge validation and immutable persistence deterministically accept one ready consistent bundled Full identity and reject malformed, blocked, or conflicting inputs before writing.

The saved bridge identity carries the exact Phase 3A resolution, projection, pack, trust, offline, and official identity fields without re-resolving, re-projecting, or granting Planning Lock authority.

A ready bundled Full preflight can be frozen once for later public routing, while unavailable or inconsistent input stops without a bridge artifact or Lite result and legacy bridge behavior remains unchanged.

positive: The bridge persists exactly one ready Phase 3A bundled Full identity without repeating resolver or projector work.
The immutable artifact retains Full mode, offline posture, resolution/projection/pack fingerprints and path, trust posture, and official provenance identity.
Unsafe, unavailable, mismatched, or conflicting inputs fail before writing or granting authority.
Repeated identical persistence reuses append-only state, while a conflicting identity cannot overwrite it.
The targeted command covers legacy bridge preservation and all new bundled identity cases.
negative: No task-start, Planning Lock, Requirements-stage, MCP, host-projection, packaging, schema, registry, CLI, or documentation wiring is changed in Phase 3B.
The persistence path does not access the network, resolve, provision, execute pack content, activate a run, or fall back to Lite.
No state outside the approved bridge owner, editable proof, and run-local managed bridge/ledger artifacts is changed.
Existing Standard and legacy explicit-manifest create behavior remains unchanged.
